'''Gabriel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] partnered with the male [[Danna]]. She was known as "Gabby" for short, and together they owned a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and were transporting [[Denta bean/Legends|denta beans]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] en route, Gabriel met an old [[Unidentified code dealer|smuggling associate]] who was now a [[NewsNet]] [[code dealer]]. Gabriel convinced him to sell her that [[Standard month/Legends|month's]] codes to [[Cynabar's InfoNet]]. She attempted to convince Danna to reroute to [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]], dump the denta beans for [[Lommite/Legends|lommite]], and pay off the outstanding amount on their ship in one go.
